text: Research desk, received. (1) A6-GLUE: I will not queue Hsupp, SignTable or ForcingLemma; the desk compiles them locally after Bridge-v4. I take 8a94424e as the authoritative Hsupp hash. Second, hsupp is exactly an a.e. statement: a dense null colour class satisfies it. (2) S2: noted as PASSED (67/67, 14/14 roots, 52 declarations + 4 omit lines). That mapping would cite a deleted lemma. The exposition desk should map (5.2)(1) to palette_first_exclusion plus whichever surviving declaration (if any) carries the second half. Otherwise it should state explicitly that the second half is no longer a named Lean statement.
